allocation.case_selection: Model chooses case_id and seed prospectively for each immutable batch, not after observing favorable results.
allocation.comparison: Development cases may already be observed; isolate changes only with same-condition evidence or allocated reference. Not an unseen population test.

eligibility.eligibility: Effective design/control change from incumbent; fresh charged complete correctly bound nominal authoritative joint pass. Perturbed-only, cached, incomplete, invalid and physical-failure results ineligible.
eligibility.freeze: Exact configuration, full incumbent-relative changes and source evidence before first verification. Rebuild only these changes on the retained source; no substitution.
eligibility.no_candidate: Run only ten unchanged-incumbent slots: worthwhile characterization of currently unmeasured perturbed incumbent. Leave ten candidate slots unused. A genuine model STOP ends search; characterization/reporting are predeclared delivery steps.
eligibility.ordering: Native completed-search reservation order replaces fixed-baseline proposal order; select first nondominated eligible nominal candidate. No hardcoded model conclusion; ties/tradeoffs retain earlier order.
eligibility.promotion: Only complete correctly bound matched evidence supports comparison; joint count and each physical metric reported separately, tradeoffs retain incumbent. No population or model-superiority claim.
eligibility.schedule: Existing five cases in frozen order, repetitions seed17 then seed18; incumbent then candidate for every slot. Fresh execution only; no retries for passing results.

instructions: Execute the accepted immutable research batch only.
